scenarios.name: inserter-diagnostics

Connect both endpoints at 400, remove connections at 700, disable both layers at 1100 and prove cleanup before removing the created hosts at 1150. All creation and cleanup work is measured; saved viewer state is not live-client or GPU evidence.
